**Headline:** Built Scalable Backend Systems for 5+ High-Traffic SaaS Platforms  
**Context:** As a Senior Backend Engineer at NexaTech Consulting, I architect and optimize backend solutions for enterprise clients, blending Go, Python, and PostgreSQL with AWS-native infrastructure. My work spans full-stack system design, performance tuning, and mentoring teams on best practices. Over the past 9 years, I’ve driven measurable improvements in system reliability and cost efficiency, including a 40% reduction in database latency for a global e-commerce platform.  
**Broader Expertise:** I specialize in designing RESTful APIs, deploying microservices with Docker, and automating CI/CD pipelines. My MongoDB expertise includes leading sharding strategies that scaled to 10M+ documents monthly. I also leverage Terraform for cloud infrastructure and Prometheus/Grafana for observability. With a focus on Python and Go, I balance innovation with operational resilience, ensuring systems meet both technical and business goals.  
**Invitation to Connect:** Let’s collaborate on solving complex backend challenges or exchange insights on scalable architecture. Reach out if you’re building systems that demand precision and performance.
